Experimental_Design.Conditions: self-matching (self vs other); reward (high vs low reward); emotion (happy vs neutral face); self-friend-stranger-matching (self/friend/stranger identity x emotion)

Block_Structure.Block_number: self-matching/reward/emotion: 2 blocks each (3 interleaved sub-tasks x 2 = 6); self-friend-stranger-matching: 6 blocks
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 96 per block (matching: 3 sub-tasks x 2 blocks); 240 per block (self-matching: 6 blocks)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Matching task: 6 geometric shapes — C.bmp=Circle (圆形), D.bmp=Diamond (菱形), S.bmp=Square (正方形), P.bmp=Pentagon (五边形), T.bmp=Triangle (三角形), Tra.bmp=Trapezoid (梯形). Self-matching task: 3 shapes × 4 emotional expressions — c=perfect circle (正圆), hc=horizontal ellipse (横椭圆), vc=vertical ellipse (竖椭圆); emotion suffix: (none)=control, _eh=happy (高兴), _en=neutral (中性), _es=sad (悲伤).
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Chinese words: 你 (self), 生人 (stranger/other), 高兴 (happy), 中性 (neutral), ￥1 (low reward), ￥16 (high reward) for matching task; 自己 (self), 朋友 (friend), 生人 (stranger) for self-matching task.

exp1.detail: Two tasks merged into one experiment: matching (Hu 2015, 3 interleaved associations: self/emotion/reward) and self-matching (Hu 2015, self-friend-stranger × emotion). Session (1-7) = lab visit / training time point (7 = subject 6031 only). Task column: matching / self-matching. Phase = practice / main. Block = global block number 1-6 (matching: 3 sub-tasks × 2 blocks renumbered — self-1=1, self-2=2, emotion-1=3, emotion-2=4, reward-1=5, reward-2=6; self-matching: 6 blocks); NA = practice. Trial = trial order within block (1-96 matching; 1-240 self-matching); NA = practice. Matching = Matching/Nonmatching (for self-matching, derived from Shape_Standardized_Identity == Label_Standardized_Identity). Shape = stimulus image filename (geometric shape for matching; circle/ellipse + emotion for self-matching; see Stimulus_Properties.Shape for the code mapping). Identity three-level columns (Shape/Label Origin/English/Standardized) follow the 6-category vocabulary (Self/Close/Stranger/NonPerson/Acquaintance/Celebrity); non-identity stimuli (happy/neutral, ￥1/￥16) kept as-is. extraIV1 = valence (positive: self/happy/high-reward; neutral: other/neutral/low-reward; NA in self-matching). extraIV2 = emotion (control/happy/neutral/sad; NA in matching). ACC: 1=correct, 0=wrong key, NA=no response. Known data issues: subject 6008 session 6 incomplete (self-matching block 3 has 113 trials instead of 240, blocks 4-6 missing); subject 6015 session 6 has one all-blank placeholder row (kept blank). Raw source: Exp1/Raw/Data_for_Exp1.csv and Data_for_Exp2.csv (GB18030 E-Prime merged exports); original per-subject-session E-Prime logs in Task1_rawdata / Task2_rawdata. 36 participants, 3 excluded from final analysis (6008, 6015, 6031) but retained per minimal-preprocessing convention. Consolidated into study Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData (Exp1) on 2026-10-04. Clean CSV is 51.7 MB (> 50 MB), split at whole-subject boundaries into Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp1_Clean_part1.csv (subjects 6001-6019, 235749 rows) and _part2.csv (subjects 6020-6036, 214280 rows); rows sorted by Subject then Task/Session/Phase/Block/Trial; the two parts share one Codebook and this experiment JSON. Standardized raw: Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp1_raw.csv (35 columns = union of Data_for_Exp1 + Data_for_Exp2 + Task). subj_info: Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp1_subj_info.csv (12 columns: Subject_ID, Exp_id, Age, Gender, Handedness, Ethnicity, Employment_Status, Country, First_Language, Education, BDI_Score, BAI_Score; Age is manually maintained per original-author confirmation, Gender/Handedness from E-Prime header, BDI/BAI from Info_participants.xlsx).
